descriptorText:
Level 1  
 
Listening  
General comprehension  
 Simple, predictable factual information is understood in short simple spoken texts.  
 A sequence of events is identified in spoken texts with a predictable linear structure.  
 
Specific comprehension  
 Straightforward explicit information is understood in short simple spoken texts when delivered 
at moderate speed in familiar accents.  
 
Awareness of sound patterns  
 Very simple emotions can sometimes be recognized from the speakers’ delivery.  
 
Integrated Skil ls 
 A few Data File instructions for simple tasks are followed in part.  
 Some relevant information is located and transferred from short simple texts.  
 Relevant content is included in the writing task if detailed cues have been given in the text(s).  
 In parts, simple basic structures and punctuation are accurate enough to be understood.  
 Basic features of familiar genres are used.  
 One or two links are made between sentences.
